verdict.rationale: A cloud hosting platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from a user's apps, logs or metrics, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows infrastructure for hosting customers' own agents (Sprites, MCP servers on Machines), an experimental flyctl MCP server for external agents, and non-AI diagnostics (`fly doctor`). None of these is an in-product AI insight or suggestion feature; they are adjacent building blocks at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
